title: Degree-zero Betti number of a derived residue unit map
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category], $s\in S$, and $a:\mathcal O_S[0]\to E$. Let $i_s:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$ be the residue-field map [def-pc-base-change], and use derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback]. If $H^0(Li_s^*a)$ is invertible, then $\beta_0(E,s)=1$, with Betti number defined in [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti]. No perfectness, boundedness, or vanishing in other degrees is assumed.

proof.text: The structure sheaf is flat: tensoring with it is naturally the identity through the right unitor. Its single complex is bounded above and termwise flat. The preadditive tensor structure used for this argument is supplied by [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed].

Apply [lem-pc-flat-complex-derived-pullback] to the single complex. Use nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction from [def-pc-module-pullback] and Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq to identify the termwise tensor pullback with ordinary pullback. The proved upstream Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso identifies ordinary pullback of the structure sheaf with the structure sheaf. Single-complex and homotopy-localization comparison isomorphisms give the private residue_unit_single_iso. This uses neither the stronger pinned tensor adjunction nor the tensor-unit theorem.

Invert H^0(Li_s^*a), compose with the single-unit comparison, and take H^0, global sections, and scalar restriction along GammaSpecIso. ModuleCat.restrictScalarsIsoOfEquiv identifies the resulting module with kappa(s) over itself. LinearEquiv.finrank_eq and Module.finrank_self finish the dimension calculation.

theorem derivedFiberBetti_zero_eq_one_of_unit_iso (S : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ x : S, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory S)
    (a : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) ⟶ E) (s : S)
    (ha : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) 0).map
        ((derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map a))) :
    derivedFiberBetti S E 0 s = 1
